-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.bootPremiseR_persistent (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id
    : w64) : Persistent (etcdstart.bootPremiseR N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id)

def etcdstart.memberBuiltR (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (id : w64) (N : Nat) (served : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ai₀ at₀ c₀ x₀, etcdstart.memberBuilt s ρ E₀ lg γn id N served ai₀ at₀ c₀ x₀)

def etcdstart.bootPremiseR (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ cfg U γ,
        ⌜etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg ∧ Uok U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
          bootstrapRestartContract cfg U γ id N dir)

def etcdstart.memberBuiltS (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (id : w64) (N : Nat) (served : Bool) (m : lease.Mode := lease.Mode.none) : IProp GF :=
  etcdstart.memberBuilt s ρ E₀ lg γn id N served (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) bootKV m fun γrn cfg E γk =>
    srvStop.keep s cfg E γrn γk
